verdict.rationale: Retell documents its own post-call analysis: built-in call success and sentiment scoring plus custom fields. It also documents a call_analyzed webhook event delivered to your server after the call, which covers delivery of outcomes via webhook. However, structured extraction of entities and dispositions rests on a single thin line about custom fields, and no evidence ties the extracted fields to the webhook or API payload. Missing for 10: documented schema for custom extraction fields (entities, dispositions), explicit confirmation that call_analyzed payloads or the API return those fields, API retrieval of analysis results, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can extract structured data from every call — outcomes, entities, dispositions — delivered via API or webhook after the call

citations.quote: Built-in call success and sentiment scoring, plus custom fields synced to your CRM.
call_started, call_ended, and call_analyzed events delivered to your server so you can react to call activity without polling
webhooks push data to your application as events happen
